title: Five physics closures and three outside-box probes: smaller high-girth Levi covers, SU(4) holonomic universality, quantized hysteretic scale memory, compressed exact three-local clocks, the full nineteen-mode Hawking channel, Pell echoes, Levi vacuum entanglement, and high-girth information velocity
purpose: Execute the five physics targets following Passes 4185-4192 and add three independent outside-box constructions with deterministic finite-model checks and strict evidence boundaries.
result: A Z_359 voltage assignment eliminates every zero-voltage base cycle of lengths 8, 10, and 12, producing a 28,720-vertex Levi cover with certified girth at least 14 and reducing the prior Z_65537 construction by a factor 182.5543. Two dense rank-two singlet holonomy bundles plus one auxiliary bright level produce exact geometric CZ; explicit Pauli commutator closure spans su(4). The saturated scale potential has a classical coexistence point with equal barrier 4.4597412117, instanton action 7.7881701215, Kramers lifetimes, and a two-state quantum-memory reduction. Exact MILP sharing reduces the existing three-local Gray clock from 96 to 61 auxiliary bits while preserving its legal gap and revival times. The complete 19-mode Gaussian horizon separates outside-to-partner steering, coherent-information, reverse-steering, and PPT thresholds and remains entangled in all 512 correlated-disorder samples at n_th=0.005 while stronger resources partially disappear. Three outside-box probes give Pell near-echoes without exact revival, exact point-line harmonic-vacuum entanglement, and a high-girth radial band velocity 2 sqrt(3) J whose capacity scaling is distinct from propagation speed.
coordination: All current Pages diagnostics and the Actions-based Pages contract remain intact. The authoritative long-form docs/index.html is never edited directly. A numerical-order reconciler places this packet after active Passes 4205-4212 when that packet publishes.
boundary: Exact finite graph-cover, holonomic-control, effective stochastic/semiclassical, clock-gadget, Gaussian-channel, spectral-recurrence, harmonic-network, and high-girth tree-band statements only. No fabricated high-girth network, experimentally universal processor, physical spacetime memory, global minimum-ancilla theorem, observed Hawking radiation, physical recurrence clock, measured vacuum entanglement, identification of graph information velocity with physical c, gravity, cosmology, or theory of everything is established.
